title: Javi Cubito in Elitecraft 4!!
body:
It is a great honor to announce that animator Javi Cubito will be participating in the fourth edition of Elitecraft representing the BBS Latin America animation community! Would you like to join us on this adventure? We await you this November 12th on his Twitch channel:
https://www.twitch.tv/javicubito_

See you soon!
